atlas.shape: curved crescent / bean-shaped strip, a little over 2:1; the segmentation map looks cut off along its flat left side; bands run parallel to the curved outer edge

tall ragged-edged rectangle (about 1:2); layers run lengthways: orange gastric glands on the left, wavy red submucosa strip in the middle, big green muscularis on the right, blue foveolae as a thin rim
half dome / rounded wedge with a flat base; thin purple edge line, green cortex rim along the curve, blue corpus albicans core with red stroma patches and a few orange flecks
irregular triangular patchwork: big orange lobules separated by branching blue connective-tissue bands
irregular hooked blob with holes and folds; orange muscle with blue fibroadipose seams
roughly square slab; large brown tubule mass in the lower/centre part, pink glomeruli band across the top and down the sides, red connective rim, a few purple medulla specks
tall teardrop / oval (about 1:1.6); thin red epithelium on the left rim, orange lamina propria band, green muscularis in the lower right bulk, blue connective rim
roughly square slab; blue fibromuscular matrix with orange acini patches (checkerboard-like) and an orange rim
squarish quadrilateral; orange parenchyma, scattered green portal-vein specks, blue connective tissue at the rim and in patches
long straight (slightly curved) band, about 6:1, in three layers: thin orange intima on the top edge, thick green media, thin blue adventitia underneath
cluster of 5 to 6 round fascicles joined together; orange nerve fibres in each, blue epineurium between and around them
small bean / oval; green fibroadipose core, blue adrenal cortex layer along the lower and right edge, thin orange tissue edge
folded two-lobed gyrus shape; purple white matter core, green grey-matter cortex round it, thin red edge
rounded blob with a small lobe at the lower right; mostly blue adenohypophysis, green neurohypophysis lobe at the lower right, thin orange rim
ring (annulus) with an open oval lumen; orange intima inside, green media, blue adventitia outside
oval / bean blob; green follicles inside, blue connective tissue rim and septa (cyst, orange, is in the legend but hardly drawn)
narrow tall strip, slightly curved (about 1:2.5); red muscularis bulk, orange adventitia / subserosa on the left, thin green mucosa on the right edge
narrow vertical oval strip (about 1:3); thin blue epidermis on the outer edge, orange papillary dermis, green reticular dermis core, red subdermis
irregular triangular chunk with a large white hole (cavity); almost all blue cardiac muscle, orange connective rim, a few green flecks
ragged net of orange fragments with many holes; a green lymph-node streak lower right, a few blue vessel specks
tall rounded rectangle (about 1:1.5); uniform green stroma with blue connective flecks and a thin red edge
small ragged crescent; orange connective tissue with red fibromuscular and green ductal patches; blue adipose bits at the edges
round cross-section (disc with a ring): green mucosa in the middle with a white lumen, red muscularis ring, orange fibromuscular outer ring
roughly round lump with ragged edge; orange seminiferous tubules, blue connective tissue patches (mostly lower centre)
wide irregular quadrilateral with an oval hole (cavity) in the middle; red myometrium dominates, green endometrium lines the hole, thin orange connective rim

tall wedge / comma, pointed at the bottom; purple cervical stroma, pink squamous epithelium on the right edge, grey tissue-edge pixels on the left and bottom, brown specks (fibromuscular tissue) almost absent
elongated vertical drop (about 1:2.3), patchy: green fibroadipose tissue, red glandular and ductal lobules, pink submucosa, purple mucosa on the right edge, brown muscularis blob at the top
narrow winding strip: finger-like folded mucosa at the top and bottom, and a thicker orange muscularis block in the lower left; blue mucosa on the outside, green submucosa inside
fan / triangle with a short stalk at the bottom; branching foliage pattern: red molecular layer and green granular layer in alternating bands, branching orange medulla tree

borderContactChangePerDecade.reading: Contacts that rise with age: Fallopian tube mucosa - fibromuscular tissue (+9.3), uterus myometrium - endometrium (+6.0), coronary artery adipose tissue with tunica media (+5.5) and with tunica intima (+5.4), ovary stroma - corpus albicans (+4.5), small intestine mucosa epithelium - muscularis (+3.3). Contacts that fall: Fallopian tube mucosa - muscularis (-7.6) and fibromuscular tissue - muscularis (-3.9), uterus myometrium - anatomical cluster 3 (-6.0), ovary stroma - cortex (-4.6), small intestine mucosa epithelium - lymphoid Peyer patches (-3.4) and muscularis - submucosa (-3.1).

borderProportionExample.what: The "proportion of touching border" is directed: of a domain pair in a small-intestine section (submucosa, lymphoid aggregate) 27% on the arrow pointing up to submucosa and 4% on the arrow pointing down to lymphoid. Which direction is which follows the arrowheads: the lymphoid aggregate has about 27% of its border against submucosa; submucosa has about 4% of its border against the aggregate.

hierarchyNetwork.description: Four-level graph: organs (dark green nodes, 29 of them: Muscle, Adipose, Skin, Uterus, Ovary, Fallopian Tube, Cervix, Vagina, Breast, Artery, Heart, Kidney, Spleen, Bladder, Prostate, Testis, Liver, Pancreas, Thyroid, Adrenal Gland, Lung, Minor Salivary Gland, Stomach, Esophagus, Colon, Small Intestine, Pituitary, Nerve, Brain) joined to their tissues (light green, e.g. Heart - Left Ventricle, Colon - Sigmoid, Skin - Not Sun Exposed), and to ten tissue-type hubs (pink-red: connective tissue (by far the biggest hub), lining epithelium, vascular tissue, adipose tissue, lymphoid structure, glandular tissue, neuronal tissue, cardiac muscle, skeletal muscle, smooth muscle) which carry the domains (light blue discs, sized by an unstated quantity; roughly 90 to 100 of them, not counted exactly, e.g. mucosa epithelium, tunica intima, ovarian stroma, seminiferous tubules). Edge weights are not readable (thin grey curves) and which hub each organ line ends at is only approximately readable.

notes: Atlas: shares are pixel shares of each segmentation map by legend colour (palette match within a small tolerance, my boxes drawn by eye), so rounded to 0.01, and they include thin outline pixels; a share of 0 means a legend entry that is hardly drawn (thyroid cyst, heart fibroadipose tissue, ectocervix fibromuscular tissue, adipose blood vessels). The small-intestine map looks cut off along its left edge in the figure itself.

Atlas colours differ from section to section (each tissue reuses a tab10-like palette: blue #1a78b6, orange #f58020, green #2ca249, red #d82a2a, purple #9268ad, brown #8c574c, pink #d87ab2, grey #939598); the same colour means different domains in different tissues. Legend spellings kept as printed (Peyer's pathches, medula, adventita subserosa, Anatomical_cluster).
Check on the brief: the atlas pituitary map is 83% adenohypophysis (blue), matching the 82.6% in the talk, so atlas shares look right.

Volcano: all 27 labelled dots and 4 unlabelled significant dots were located by pixel analysis against the axis ticks (x +-0.01, y +-0.05). The y axis is a natural log although labelled -log (see yScaleNote). Tissue names come from panels d/e dot colours and their legend; four dots have uncertain tissue (connective tissue +1.26 light purple, endometrium inferred, and the four unlabelled ones). 31 significant dots in total; the number of non-significant dots is only an estimate.

The drawn regression lines in 18f-h do not have the slopes printed in the same panels (four are 35 to 60% steeper than the printed slope (f, both Testis panels, Vagina), two are 6% and 15% shallower (g, adenohypophysis)), the label slope is probably from a model with covariates. The line values are what is drawn; use the printed slope as the paper number. Panel f line: 43.1% to 35.6%, near the talk numbers 42.9 to 34.5 for the GI submucosa.

The talk numbers for the ovary (1.4% to 11.89%) are not what panel g draws (0 at 25 y.o. to 0.15 at 70); the straight line reaches 0.151 at 70, and the individual slides spread to 0.6. The pituitary numbers differ by a factor of 2 (see its trajectory note). I cannot say which is "right"; I only report the figure.

Image19 b curves: read in 5-year steps (points = every 10 years as asked, pointsMid = 25, 35, ... 65); band edges are the drawn shaded band, which dips below 0. The tissue is not named in the panel (the schematic is a vessel); y is "Domain abundance (%)" with axes 0 to 5 (calcified plaques), 0 to 0.6+ (atherosis), 0 to 0.6+ (infarct tissue), 0 to 1.0+ (inflammatory aggregates and hemorrhage).

Image20 coronary-artery networks (panel i): edge widths measured by pixel analysis along each node pair (grey #939598 lines, node centres from the coloured discs). The smooth muscle - connective tissue edge is very thick and short (the nodes overlap and the text covers part of it), so its width (12 to 14 px) is the least certain; it is the thickest edge in every panel and I used it as weight 1.0. Other edges 1 to 4 px (+-0.5). Edges can hide behind nodes: lines from connective tissue to adipose tissue or cardiac muscle pass through the smooth-muscle disc, so I tested each node pair for a line along the whole centre-to-centre path (an edge counted only if it is visible beside the discs). Widths may be normalised per panel (the thickest is always the same), so only the relative ranking inside a panel is safe, not the absolute change of one edge between ages.

Panel i reading: adipose tissue contacts with smooth muscle and with connective tissue thicken with age (about 0.21 to 0.29 and absent to 0.30 of the thickest edge) and adipose tissue - cardiac muscle goes 0.11, 0.19, 0.12 and is absent from 50-59 on; the cardiac muscle links with smooth muscle and connective tissue peak at 30-39 and fall after. This agrees in sign with panel e (coronary artery adipose tissue with tunica media and intima +5.5 and +5.4 per decade), but panel e uses domain names, not tissue types.

Not in image20: no stomach-versus-uterus pair of networks and no organ-clustering dendrogram. Panel b shows Stomach, Small intestine (terminal ileum), Breast and Minor salivary gland; the uterus appears only in panel e (domain pairs) and its colour legend. If stomach vs uterus is on another slide it is in a figure I was not given.

Not read: individual slide dots in the trajectory scatter plots; the mean-combined-score definition; image17; node sizes in image20 panel a; the H&E images themselves. Image18 panel i has no unit for Density_domain and its domain is not printed (title says Colon - Transverse, or submucosa Stomach).

Panel e of image20: -log10 p values are estimated from marker sizes only; markers below the legend minimum (2.5) are given as null. The x axis of that panel is clipped at 10 (label cut off) and the units of border contact are as printed (no unit word).
